# Ayush.company | Custom AI Voice Agents & Automation Agency

> Ayush.company is a B2B AI engineering and voice automation agency based in Delhi NCR, India. We build low-latency (sub-500ms) Hinglish and English AI Voice Agents, automated lead qualification workflows, and interactive Next.js web systems for real estate developers, brokerages, and marketing agencies.

## Core Services & Solutions
- [AI Voice Agents for Real Estate](https://ayush.company/ai-voice-agent-for-real-estate): Instant 15-second outbound callback systems for 99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, and Meta Ads leads. Automates buyer qualification and site-visit booking in fluent Hinglish and English.
- [AI Voice Agent Agency in Delhi NCR](https://ayush.company/ai-voice-agent-delhi-ncr): Custom inbound and outbound AI telecalling systems for businesses in New Delhi, Gurugram, and Noida.
- [White-Label AI & Interactive Web Partner](https://ayush.company/white-label-ai-partner): Fractional frontend (Next.js/React/Tailwind) and AI backend (Supabase/Vapi/Retell) execution for global creative and marketing agencies.
- [Dubai AI Studio & Real Estate Telephony](https://ayush.company/dubai): Autonomous voice agents and 3D WebGL portals for prime UAE real estate and family offices.
- [Solutions Directory](https://ayush.company/solutions): Master index of 100+ verified conversational AI, real estate automation, and CRM solutions.

## Key Performance Benchmarks
- Call Trigger Speed: Under 15 seconds from CRM or webhook lead capture
- Voice Latency: 400ms to 600ms conversational response time (435ms measured)
- Supported Languages: English, Hindi, and conversational Hinglish (seamless code-switching)
- Integrations: HubSpot, Zoho CRM, LeadSquared, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, WhatsApp Business API, 99acres, MagicBricks, Google Calendar
